name: Acqua di Gio
description: A timeless aquatic fresh fragrance with bergamot, neroli, jasmine, and sea accord. A go-to for warm weather.

name: Sauvage
description: Bold and noble, opening with bergamot and Sichuan pepper over a warm ambroxan base. Versatile and long-lasting.

name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Sophisticated blend of citrus, woods, and clean musks. Polished and versatile for all occasions.

name: Light Blue
description: A fresh Mediterranean citrus fragrance with Sicilian lemon, apple, and cedarwood. Light and summery.

name: 1 Million
description: Gold-drenched, magnetic blend of blood mandarin, cinnamon, leather, and patchouli. Best for cooler evenings.

name: Spicebomb
description: An explosive blend of chili, saffron, tobacco, and vetiver. A cold-weather powerhouse for evenings.

name: L'Homme
description: Clean and subtle with notes of ginger, bergamot, and white pepper over cedar and vetiver. Excellent for office use.

name: Y EDP
description: A modern masculine with sage, apple, ginger, and amberwood. Fresh yet warm and versatile.

name: Stronger With You
description: Seductive blend of pink pepper, chestnut, salvia, and vanilla. Perfect for dates and evenings.

name: Encre Noire
description: Dark and enigmatic with vetiver, cypress, and cashmeran. A brooding cold-weather fragrance.

name: Terre d'Hermès
description: A journey through earth and mineral with flint, orange, and vetiver. Understated elegance.

name: Explorer
description: An adventurous blend of bergamot, Haitian vetiver, and musk. Versatile for everyday wear.

name: A*Men
description: An iconic gourmand masculine with coffee, caramel, patchouli, and tar. A cold-weather powerhouse.

name: Cool Water
description: A classic aquatic fougère with mint, coriander, geranium, and sandalwood. Refreshing and inoffensive.

name: Invictus
description: A sporty aquatic masculine with grapefruit, guaiac wood, and ambergris. Energetic and crowd-pleasing.

name: The One
description: Warm and sensual with grapefruit, basil, cardamom, tobacco, and amber. A sophisticated evening fragrance.

name: Boss Bottled
description: A classic masculine with apple, cinnamon, sandalwood, and cedar. Timeless and office-appropriate.

name: Legend
description: A fresh aromatic masculine with bergamot, lavender, rose, and sandalwood. Reliable and well-rounded.

name: Eros
description: A passionate blend of fresh mint, Italian lemon, green apple, vanilla, and cedarwood. Bold and seductive.

name: Aventus
description: A legendary fragrance with blackcurrant, bergamot, pineapple, birch, and musk. Versatile and prestigious.

name: Chrome
description: A clean, fresh aquatic citrus with lemon, neroli, coriander, and oakmoss. A safe inoffensive choice.

name: Le Male
description: An iconic lavender, mint, vanilla, and musk fragrance. Warm and sensual for evenings.

name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme
description: A minimalist aquatic with yuzu, coriander, nutmeg, and sandalwood. Subtle and perfectly inoffensive.

name: Ombre Leather
description: A bold leather fragrance with cardamom, jasmine, patchouli, and white moss. Best for fall and winter.

name: Hero EDP
description: A powerful woody blend of juniper, black pepper, cedarwood, and elemi resin. Confident and polished.

name: Acqua di Gio Profumo
description: A deeper, more intense take on Acqua di Gio with marine, incense, and patchouli. Versatile and impressive.

name: Fahrenheit
description: An unconventional leather and violet accord layered over hawthorn and vetiver. An artful evening fragrance.

name: Dylan Blue
description: A Mediterranean aquatic with grapefruit, violet leaf, patchouli, and musk. Fresh and modern.

name: La Nuit de L'Homme
description: A seductive night-time fragrance with cardamom, cedar, vetiver, and coumarin. Made for cold evenings.

name: Invictus Aqua
description: An ultra-fresh aquatic burst of cucumber, marine, and grapefruit over woody musks. Perfect for summer heat.
